chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Khālid, from his father, from al-Qāsim ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about al-Qāʾim عليه السلام, so he said: “The time-setters have lied. We are a Household who do not set a time.”

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: the Household; the family of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْقَائِمِ: al-Qāʾim, the awaited Imam who will rise by Divine command
key_terms.الْوَقَّاتُونَ: those who assign or specify a time for the reappearance
key_terms.كَذَبَ: has lied; a direct denunciation of a false claim
key_terms.لَا نُوَقِّتُ: we do not appoint or specify a time

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about setting a time for the reappearance of al-Qāʾim عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith rejects specifying a fixed time for the rise of al-Qāʾim عليه السلام. It teaches that Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام did not designate a date for this matter, and it warns against claims of precise timing regarding the reappearance.
